items.title: David Spinozza interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, NY, September 27, 2025
items.q: In fact there’s a joke about it. There’s two musicians or something, they’re talking one day. And this one musician says to the other musician, “Did you hear last week I played a score for a movie?” And then the other one said, “Did you hear I met Marilyn Monroe? I’m sleeping with Marilyn Monroe.”

ctx.x: And so the contractors would like – © Fillius Jazz Archive -7-

And the contractor would know and if the producers complained to the contractor, “I don’t want to see that guy again” or whatever, that would be it. That’s why it was so stressful because you really were only as good as your last phone call. You were never sure there was going to be another session. In fact there’s a joke about it.
